title: Austin Spirits & Spirits Haunted Pub Crawl
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not for travelers under the age of 21.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Austin, Texas, is a vibrant city that prides itself on its weirdness. In fact, one of the mottos of the city is "Keep Austin Weird", and the city is home to the Museum of the Weird. On this tour, you'll encounter the weird of the paranormal sort. From the "Lady in White" to the spirit of a lady of the night, you'll discover some of Austin's most famous spirits. Along the way, you can sample spirits of the drinking kind. After all, you may need the liquid courage!

* Alcohol is not included in the price of the tour, though you are welcome to purchase your own at the bars we visit.
